title: Sea Pearl Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Sea Pearl is a luxurious two-bedroom cottage in Seaside, Florida with stylish décor that includes original artwork by local artists.
description_expanded: Description674 FOREST STREET1 KING, 1 QUEEN, 1 SLEEPER SOFALuxury Cottage Living in the Heart of Seaside, FloridaSea Pearl is a beautifully appointed two-bedroom luxury cottage in Seaside, Florida, offering refined coastal style and thoughtful design throughout. Adorned with original artwork by local artists, this elegant retreat blends upscale finishes with the relaxed charm Seaside is known for. From the moment you arrive, the open-air front porch with Adirondack seating and the dramatic two-story walls of windows create a welcoming and light-filled first impression.Open-Concept Living & Gourmet KitchenStep inside to a stunning foyer featuring a graceful curved staircase that sets the tone for the home’s sophisticated design. The first floor offers a highly sought-after open-concept layout, ideal for entertaining and gathering. The living area features a plush sofa sleeper for additional guests and a 55-inch flat-screen Smart TV, making it a comfortable space to relax after a day at the beach.Across from the living area, the dining space comfortably seats six and flows seamlessly into the recently remodeled gourmet kitchen. Designed for both function and style, the kitchen boasts granite countertops, a large center island, bar seating for two, and top-of-the-line Viking and Bosch appliances—perfect for preparing everything from casual breakfasts to coastal-inspired dinners. A convenient half bath completes the first level.Private Bedroom Retreats & Elegant BathsUpstairs, Sea Pearl offers two serene bedroom suites, both accessible via the home’s beautiful curved staircase. The primary bedroom features a king bed, cozy seating area, built-in bookcases, and a 55-inch flat-screen Smart TV. The spa-like ensuite bath includes marble flooring and a large glass-enclosed rain shower, creating a peaceful retreat at the end of the day.The second bedroom is equally inviting, offering a queen bed, flat-screen TV, and access to a full hall bath—ideal for family or guests.Outdoor Balcony Living Under the StarsBoth bedrooms open directly onto a shared open-air balcony porch, furnished with a sofa lounger and Adirondack seating. This elevated outdoor space is perfect for enjoying warm Seaside evenings, coastal breezes, and starlit nights—whether you’re winding down with a glass of wine or starting the morning with coffee.Sea Pearl delivers an elevated Seaside vacation experience with luxurious interiors, thoughtful design, and inviting outdoor spaces—making it the perfect coastal escape for couples, families, or friends seeking refined comfort just moments from the beach.Need more room, check out the rear guest cottage Oyster Cottage, a one-bedroom new build construction that sleeps four!* Please be advised that some exterior areas of this home are under video surveillance.* 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer; 3 night minimum Fall, and 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registrationFEATURESFeatures 1,878 square feetSeaside Private Residential Beach at West Ruskin Pavilion4-minute walk, 352 yards to beach accessPeacock Alley Linens – Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 Clay tennis courts, and 3 Pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking: 2 parking passes are issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002353
